name: Langman Jiari
source:
Romantic Journey is a Japanese-style visual novel game in which the protagonist, for a variety of reasons, takes a romantic holiday trip with the ladies of the boss's family.

[From [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/961920/]Steam[/url]]
translation:
《浪漫之旅》是一款日式视觉小说游戏，主角因为种种原因，与老板娘们进行一场浪漫的假期旅行。

[来自[url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/961920/]Steam[/url]]
